prayerExcerpt.en-US: May the fruits of his labors remain ever abundant in your Church.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Que os frutos do seu trabalho permaneçam na vossa Igreja com perene fecundidade.

meta.face: A tall Roman monk of about fifty-five with a SLENDER, finely boned LONG face and gently hollowed cheeks — a smooth, high forehead, a narrow, high-bridged nose, large, grave dark-brown eyes with dark lashes under long, level dark brows, a small, firm mouth; dark hair streaked with grey in a monastic crown around the tonsure; a SHORT, SQUARE-CUT dark beard streaked with grey, trimmed straight across at the bottom; a calm, resolute gaze toward the horizon.
meta.basis: Bede tells how he met King Æthelberht on Thanet bearing a silver cross for a banner and an image of the Saviour painted on a board; he had been prior of St Andrew's on the Caelian in Rome. No description of his face survives, so it is our choice, kept apart from Augustine of Hippo (olive, close-cropped, short round beard) and Gregory the Great.
